title: HEVI Differentiation Program — Phase D1: Why users MUST pick HEVI (vs. HEVI can also do it)

explicit_scope_statement.production_closure_scope: P0/P1 production-semantic parity/closure — NOT 115/115 feature parity.
explicit_scope_statement.closure_statement: 3119 passed / 29 skipped / 0 failed / 0 errors. 39/39 qualified. 3O_ARCHITECTURE_ZERO=PASS. P0=0. P1=0.

D1-A.name: Verified lip-sync talking head (digital human)
D1-A.constraint: STRONG claim. Historical GPU blockers (RTX 3080 Xid 79/154, 'engine unavailable') must NOT be auto-passed as verified.
D1-A.compound_system: Talking head + real audio + verified lip-sync (one verified digital-human output).
D1-A.why_must_pick: Verified talking head with lip-sync is a compound differentiator: real audio + real video + verified lip-sync, not a single capability.

D1-B.name: Verified local + hybrid generation (self-hosted model access)
D1-B.constraint: Local + hybrid generation (model access, not provider-only).
D1-B.compound_system: Local + hybrid model access with verified model cards.
D1-B.why_must_pick: Local + hybrid generation is a compound differentiator: model access, not provider-only.

D-C.name: Verified character/story continuity (multi-character)
D-C.why_must_pick: Character continuity across episodes is a compound differentiator.

D1-D.name: Verified production graph + auto-repair (pipeline robustness)
D1-D.constraint: HEVI has a durable production graph with auto-repair (crash recovery).
D1-D.compound_system: Durable production graph with auto-repair (crash recovery).
D1-D.why_must_pick: Production graph + auto-repair is a compound differentiator.

D1-E.name: Verified talking head WITHOUT lip-sync (distinct from verified lip-sync)
D1-E.constraint: 'talking head without lip-sync' must remain distinct from 'verified lip-sync'.
D1-E.compound_system: Talking head without lip-sync (a real capability, distinct from verified lip-sync).
D1-E.why_must_pick: Talking head without lip-sync is a distinct differentiator from verified lip-sync.

D1-F.name: Verified multi-user security (ArcReel single-admin only = background)
D1-F.constraint: ArcReel's single-admin only is treated only as background, not as HEVI's own proof.
D1-F.why_must_pick: Multi-user security is a compound differentiator; ArcReel single-admin only is background, not HEVI's own proof.

D1-G.name: Verified creative memory (personalization)
D1-G.why_must_pick: Creative memory/personalization is a compound differentiator.

compound_systems.distinctness: D1-E (talking head without lip-sync) is a separate compound system and must remain distinct from D1-A (verified lip-sync).

hypotheses.claim: Verified talking head with lip-sync (D1-A) is a MUST pick differentiator (not 'can also do it').
hypotheses.rationale: D1-A is the STRONG claim: verified talking head + real audio + verified lip-sync. GPU blockers are not auto-passed.

hypotheses.claim: Local + hybrid generation (D1-B) is a MUST pick differentiator (model access, not provider-only).
hypotheses.rationale: D1-B compounds model access + local generation, not provider-only.

hypotheses.claim: Character/story continuity across episodes (D-C) is a MUST pick differentiator.
hypotheses.rationale: D-C compounds canonical state + audit + revision across episodes.

hypotheses.claim: Production graph + auto-repair (D1-D) is a MUST pick differentiator.
hypotheses.rationale: D1-D compounds durable graph + crash recovery.

hypotheses.claim: Multi-user security (D1-F) is a MUST pick differentiator.
hypotheses.rationale: D1-F compounds multi-admin + scoped API keys. ArcReel single-admin only is background.

hypotheses.claim: Creative memory/personalization (D1-G) is a MUST pick differentiator.

top3_implementation_candidates: D1-A (verified lip-sync talking head) — the strongest compound claim
D-C (character/story continuity) — the most differentiated compound
D1-D (production graph + auto-repair) — the most robust compound
